About.title: About Us
About.section1P1: Meubel Jati Abror is born from a proud family woodworking legacy in Jepara, dedicated to honoring authentic hand joinery. Every piece of solid teak is hand-selected, kiln-dried for dimensional stability, and joined using mortise-and-tenon wooden joinery without rust-prone nails.
About.section1P2: Meticulous manual assembly provides structural integrity tested across time. To us, genuine furniture is not mass-manufactured, but an heirloom piece with warmth and character that endures for generations.
About.section2Title: The Harmony of Solid Teak, Natural Cane, & Direct Custom Woodcraft
About.section2P1: We blend the timeless durability of solid teak with the supple warmth of handwoven natural rattan. This union creates a refined mid-century modern and Japandi aesthetic that is visually light, tactile, and naturally breathable.
About.section2P2: Operating directly from our workshop in Tahunan, Jepara, every piece is crafted under one roof without retail markups. You have total freedom to customize dimensions, wood finishes, and project specifications directly with our master craftsmen.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At Meubel Jati Abror, we respect your personal data and privacy. This policy outlines how we handle the information you provide during consultation and checkout.
Privacy.sec1Text: When placing an inquiry or cart order, we collect: Full name, active WhatsApp/phone number, delivery address (including city and postal code), and optional email. This information is exclusively used for order verification, cargo shipping calculations, and delivery waybills.
Privacy.sec2Text: Your details are strictly used internally by Meubel Jati Abror and shared only with our designated freight truck drivers for physical delivery. We NEVER sell, lease, or distribute your private information to third parties.
Privacy.sec3Text: Order discussions and transaction confirmations take place directly via our verified WhatsApp channels. We uphold absolute confidentiality regarding payment transfers and client details.
Privacy.sec4Text: If you wish to update or remove your details from our records, please contact our workshop team via WhatsApp or email us at meubeljatiabror@gmail.com.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Ordering
Terms.intro: These terms govern the ordering workflow, installment payments, cargo freight logistics, and product warranty at Meubel Jati Abror to ensure complete transparency between buyers and our artisan workshop.
Terms.sec1Text: Orders are initiated through our online catalog and finalized via verified WhatsApp communication. Clients may customize furniture dimensions, teak grades, and finishing colors (Natural Teak, Salak Brown, Dark Walnut, etc.) prior to production.
Terms.sec2Text: For made-to-order and bespoke items, a 30% to 50% down payment is required to secure raw lumber and begin crafting. The remaining balance (50%) is settled upon completion, verified via detailed Quality Control photos and videos before cargo dispatch.
Terms.sec3Text: Deliveries are dispatched directly from our Jepara workshop via specialized door-to-door furniture freight carriers across Java, Bali, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, and overseas ports. Items are protected with 3 layers: anti-scratch foamsheet, heavy corrugated single-face carton, and solid wood corner crates.
Terms.sec4Text: Freight rates are determined transparently based on total volume (cubic meters) and distance. Shipping costs can be paid directly to the freight driver upon arrival (COD Freight) or transferred along with the final invoice.
Terms.sec5Text: Customers are encouraged to inspect furniture upon handover. We guarantee replacement or repair for structural defects in joinery or solid wood stability. For minor transit scuffs, touch-up materials or local repair reimbursements are promptly provided.

Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Faq.description: Essential details regarding bespoke orders, cargo freight delivery from Jepara, and craftsmanship warranties.
Faq.q1: Are all pieces crafted from 100% authentic solid teak wood?
Faq.a1: Yes, every piece at Meubel Jati Abror is crafted exclusively from selected solid teak timber (never particle board or MDF). We employ traditional Jepara mortise-and-tenon joinery with solid wood dowels for extreme durability spanning decades.
Faq.q2: How does freight shipping work for inter-island destinations?
Faq.a2: We ship using specialized furniture freight trucks operating directly out of Jepara, delivering door-to-door to your residence or project site. Every unit is packaged in 3 protective layers: shock-absorbing foam, heavy single-face carton, and corner wooden crating.
Faq.q3: Can I pay in installments with a Down Payment (DP)?
Faq.a3: Yes. Custom orders require an initial 30%–50% DP to commence woodwork. The final balance is only settled once production is complete and you have inspected our comprehensive QC video and photo inspection.
Faq.q4: What happens if a piece is damaged or scuffed during transit?
Faq.a4: We provide transit peace-of-mind. Minor surface scuffs receive a color-matched touch-up kit or local artisan repair compensation. For structural freight damage, we repair or replace the affected unit as agreed.
Faq.q5: Can I request custom sizes, designer drawings, or specialized finishes?
Faq.a5: Absolutely. As a direct maker workshop, we welcome architectural schematics, bespoke room dimensions, and diverse finishes including Natural Teak, Salak Brown, Dark Walnut, Bleached Scandinavian, and Matte/Gloss Duco.
